resources.string: Runs as root immediately before the selected SU late-load (the actual insmod stage). Failure is logged but does not stop late-load.
Runs as root immediately after a successful late-load, before optional soft reboot. Failure is logged but does not stop the run.
Enabled for the next run: before late-load / insmod.
Enabled for the next run: after late-load / insmod.
One shell script. Lines starting with # are comments.
Runs through /system/bin/sh. Before root this uses the app UID; after root, use your SU command if your manager exposes one.
